benchmarks.label: fast-preview-final-teapot
benchmarks.scope: Native float films, same scene/emission convention and angular resolution. First-pass timing includes geometry construction; steady timing excludes 2 passes. Equal-time pass counts are chosen from measured steady cost and capped at1024; inspect actual render time in timing.json. LaunchSeconds includes process/setup cost. Nonblack caustic films and sheet counts establish that structure is drawn; visual quality is not reduced to a timing ratio. Preview is biased, filters folds and omits camera-side specular sheet paths. Mode20 is tested only for disabled byte preservation because its emission convention differs from this preview.

charts.title: Time to the first native film

scope: Compact offline presentation of retained native outputs. PNGs are byte copies; no rendering or image enhancement is performed here. Float film SHA-256 values come from native result records; large films are not copied or rehashed by this builder. A flagged intensity outlier may be localized by read-only access to its original float film. Matched benchmark fields are checked. A nonblack finite film is output evidence, not an unbiasedness or convergence proof. Preview filtering, finite angular resolution and omitted camera-side specular sheet paths introduce bias. First-pass, steady-pass and process-launch timings are distinct measurements.
